name: 'Meiping' Bottle with Stylized Lotus Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；16th century；Cizhou-type ware: light gray stoneware with medium brown glaze over white slip, the decoration incised into the glaze before firing to reveal the white slip. Place of manufacture uncertain--probably from northern China.
